name: Aero Tire

origin.basis: CADEX is the Giant Group's component brand (its site footer links to Giant Group); Giant Group was founded in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: No source states where the tire is made.

weight_basis: Specified weight as quoted by Bicycle Rolling Resistance; no CADEX product page was found.

availability.note: No CADEX product page was found on 2026-11-01; retailer listings appeared in search results but could not be read (403, 404 or timeouts).

caveats: Safety warning from the lab: a 21 mm tread on a 28 mm tire, with very thin sidewalls; the reviewers say it can only be used safely on straights and rate it 'Not Recommended'.
Identity and sizes come from the independent lab page; no CADEX product page or readable retailer listing was found.
Measured only 26 mm wide, so its rolling-resistance result sits in the 80 psi band and is not compared with 28-30 mm tires.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components review lists and every Bicycle Rolling Resistance reader comment on this tire's test pages. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this exact model and, where it is sold in more than one construction or generation, say which; seller and shop posts, questions, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. The shop's own unboxing post is not counted.

reports.summary: Used for several months and finds it really good.
